cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. That ink on your new sofa must be from the delivery label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The label's dry. You signed with your fountain pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then the driver brushed my signature against the fabric. We should photograph it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pen's still leaking onto the cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The delivery must have cracked it when they squeezed past me. Photograph the pen too; that's a second claim.

mechanism: A grades its pupil observation skills while turning each incriminating ink detail into support for blaming the delivery.
confusable: Not investigation open to A fault: every new observation is redirected outward before responsibility settles on A.
comparison: Shifting origin of a stain versus shifting cause of failed installation.
seedUse: D133 sofa/label/pen/leak/delivery claim; S05 coaching close observation.
